source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 1
2. Run Diagnostic-Test via cmd: dcgmi diag -v -r diagnostic
3. Disable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 0

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. The result of Diagnostic-Test should be PASS without errors.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Uses unverified `dcgmi diag --diagnostic` and omits source persistence transitions.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Full diagnostic output and every sub-test PASS.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES but incorrectly describes a potentially multi-subsystem diagnostic as read-only and omits persistence and safety context.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; requires explicit sub-test matrix, workload isolation, subsystem telemetry and restoration.

original_test_intent: Run the specified DCGM diagnostic suite on the approved GPU set, retain each required sub-test result, verify no diagnostic or correlated system errors, and restore the approved persistence state.
original_method: Resolve the deployed `diagnostic` suite syntax and included plugins, capture GPU/MIG/memory/PCIe/ECC/thermal/workload state, run the source persistence and verbose suite sequence with Safety Stops, and assess each required sub-result rather than only an aggregate exit status.
manual_activity: An authorized user approves the fixed suite scope, workload window, Safety Stops and restoration. Suite execution and evidence collection are software-controlled, so approval or final engineering judgment does not make the core PARTIAL.
required_inputs: Compatible DCGM/dcgmi, NVIDIA driver and stable GPU/DCGM identity map
Installed-version proof for source `-v -r diagnostic` or documented equivalent
Required sub-test matrix with PASS/SKIP/NOT RUN disposition
Workload/MIG blackout and memory, PCIe, ECC, thermal, power and timeout limits
Persistence final state, OOB recovery and plan approval
safety_requirements: Quiesce protected workloads and MIG clients and verify capacity for every included diagnostic plugin.
Continuously enforce plugin-appropriate power, thermal, ECC, PCIe, timeout and device-health Safety Stops.
Preserve every PASS/FAIL/SKIP/NOT RUN section plus raw events; never collapse partial coverage into an aggregate PASS.
No automatic retry, GPU reset, client termination, counter clearing, service restart or alternate syntax guess.
Restore only the approved persistence state.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve exact suite membership and syntax, validate target identity, blackout and per-plugin safety gates.
Execute the approved persistence/suite plan and collect full per-sub-test output and synchronized subsystem evidence.
Apply Safety Stop, restore state, compare events and report Tool Result without issuing the formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the required sub-test matrix, skip policy, target scope, blackout, limits and restoration/recovery plan.
Decide disposition for unsupported, skipped, partial or Safety-Stopped sub-tests.
Review all sub-results and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `--diagnostic` is not proven equivalent to source `-v -r diagnostic` for the installed DCGM and also omits persistence transitions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the source command until installed-version help or NVIDIA documentation proves an equivalent spelling and identical suite composition.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The diagnostic selector, verbosity, both persistence steps, criterion, script and 2/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: SOURCE DIAGNOSTIC SUITE RETAINED WITH SUBTEST ACCOUNTING
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the suite's resolved plugin list before execution and produce a matrix of required versus executed PASS/FAIL/SKIP/NOT RUN results with correlated subsystem evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: NVIDIA GPUs and DCGM releases supporting the selected diagnostic suite.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record DCGM/dcgmi, driver, GPU firmware, MIG/ECC mode, OS/kernel and BMC versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA DCGM diagnostics documentation for the deployed release and referenced project script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit suite-membership and skip accounting, stable identity and Safety Stop controls without substituting a different diagnostic.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; makes partial coverage visible.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Required plugin matrix and skip policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Suite membership may vary by DCGM release and hardware, so the selector name alone does not establish equal coverage.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define the required plugins, GPU set and limits. Any omitted or unsupported plugin must be reported explicitly; the executed suite cannot be represented as broader coverage.
expected_evidence: Versions, stable identities, suite/plugin resolution and required sub-test matrix
Full verbose output, per-sub-test statuses, timestamps, duration and return code
Live telemetry, post events, Safety Stop if any and restoration evidence
Tool Result separated from engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source title, command and criterion consistently identify the DCGM diagnostic suite; the historical alternate spelling is an applicability question rather than contradictory source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The suite intent is clear. Missing package, suite matrix or project limits are execution-readiness inputs, not a permanent semantic block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects the read-only characterization and restores persistence, suite membership and subsystem-safety coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its per-sub-test and recovery controls while correcting automation capability from approval-gated PARTIAL to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates automated Tool Result from engineering verdict and applies one-plan approval, no-retry and Safety Stop.

review_improvement: Prevents an aggregate process result from concealing skipped or failed sub-tests and prevents suite coverage from drifting between DCGM releases.
independent_technical_reasoning: All core actions—suite resolution, diagnostic execution, telemetry, event correlation and state restoration—are machine-executable. Human approval and final acceptance are governance inputs, not physical participation.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: Do not rerun failed/skipped sub-tests, try alternate selectors, reset GPUs, clear counters, terminate clients or retoggle persistence automatically.
